verified_source_finding: No SVC, SVR, Nystroem, RBFSampler or PolynomialFeatures reference in current registered src; existing broad products and fixed linear screens do not measure these representations.
base: Isolated exact CP1B; retain strong V11/V16 and CP1/B. Do not combine with the new loss factor.

experiments.factor: Opt-in bounded nonlinear representation recipe and executable adapter contracts
required: default portfolio and ordinary planner unchanged
finite transforms and original target scale
exact source and unpacked technical checks
experiments.first_candidate: RBFSampler with fixed128 components followed by Ridge or LogisticRegression; final gamma and all fitting parameters must be pinned before public execution

experiments.hypothesis: A bounded RBF representation can recover nonlinear structure absent from the tested fixed linear recipe or provide useful complementary errors.
experiments.unit: Fixed recipes, not whole agent or Qwen skill gain
arms: new matched linear recipe without kernel mapping
same new recipe plus fixed RBFSampler mapping
experiments.cuts: Same3 immutable forward regression cuts and2 immutable group classification cuts as completed METH screens
experiments.fairness: Within kernel-versus-linear comparison hold preparation, rows, regularization, seeds, weights, target transform and evaluation fixed. A changed preparation versus the old METH02 recipe is a recipe comparison, not a pure kernel effect.
experiments.quality: Independent pristine-label recomputation. Each task candidate must beat strong SINGLE on every declared cut; classification additionally support/ex-rarest gates. Record matched-linear comparison separately. Cost or valid proposals alone cannot promote.
experiments.readiness: Requires KERN00 actual gates, exact fixed profile/recipe/source/input/split/evaluator pins and independent source review/publication. No automatic launch or registration as default candidate.

experiments.factor: Bounded numeric PolynomialFeatures degree2 plus regularized learner versus its matched linear recipe
experiments.required: Pin numeric feature admission from fitting rows, exact output count, matrix cap and fixed preprocessing before fits; categories handled separately. No full unbounded polynomial expansion.

experiments.factor: Nystroem or exact SVC/SVR feasibility, separately
experiments.required: Observed fitting scale and explicit cost-only gate, strict time/memory/sample/probability-calibration caps; no claiming subsampled feasibility as full-data quality. SVC probability cost belongs to original budget.

experiments.factor: Qwen nonlinear-representation skill versus same bounded non-LLM catalog and current search under equal all-inclusive budgets
experiments.required: Actual adapter/catalog readiness, new same fitting-only diagnostic builder and provenance, no outer feedback; cost includes API, refit, CSV and audit. Fixed blend validation separately if complementarity is promising.

history: Fixed linear and ET negatives preserved. No replay without a new mechanism. All heavy suites/fits/audits serial.
